name: pilotControl_throttle
description: Pilot throttle control position

name: pilotControl_long
description: Longitudinal (pitch) control position

name: pilotControl_lat
description: Lateral (roll) control position

name: pilotControl_yaw
description: Directional (yaw) control position

name: stabilityAugmentationOn_disc
description: Stability augmentation engage flag (discrete); 1 = SAS engaged, 0 = SAS off

name: autopilotOn_disc
description: Autopilot engage flag (discrete); 1 = AP engaged, 0 = AP off (forces SAS on)

name: selectCircumnavigator_disc
description: Selects which navigator to use: 1 = circle N pole; 0 = circle equator/Int'l date line intersection

name: geLatitude
description: Geodetic latitude of vehicle CM, +north of equator

name: geLongitude
description: Geodetic longitude of vehicle CM, +east of prime meridian

name: equivalentAirspeedCommand
description: Equivalent airspeed command (kt) to autospeed logic

name: altitudeMslCommand
description: Commanded altitude above sea level (ft) for autopilot

name: altitudeMsl
description: Geometric altitude above mean sea level (ft)

name: equivalentAirspeed
description: Equivalent airspeed (kt)

name: angleOfAttack
description: Angle of attack (deg)

name: angleOfSideslip
description: Angle of sideslipe (deg), +wind in the pilot's right ear

name: eulerAngle_Roll
description: Roll angle of vehicle relative to local level (deg), +right wing down

name: eulerAngle_Pitch
description: Pitch angle of vehicle relative to local level (deg), +nose up

name: eulerAngle_Yaw
description: Yaw angle of vehicle relative to true North (deg), +clockwise

name: bodyAngularRate_Roll
description: Vehicle body-axis roll rate (rad/s), +right wing down

name: bodyAngularRate_Pitch
description: Vehicle body-axis pitch rate (rad/s), +aircraft nose up

name: bodyAngularRate_Yaw
description: Vehicle body-axis yaw rate (rad/s) +aircraft nose right

name: trimmedPilotControl_throttle
description: Trimmed position of throttle

name: trimmedPilotControl_long
description: Trimmed position of pitch control

name: forceStabAugOn_disc
description: This flag is on ( > 0.5) if either stability augmentation or autopilot functions have been selected on to ensure stability if autopilot has been requested; 1 = SAS engaged, 0 = SAS off

name: autopilotAltErrorFeedbackGain
description: Gain in altitude compensator to vary pitch angle from trimmed based on altitude error; positive altitude error (meaning above reference altitude) results in a reduction of commanded pitch angle.

name: autopilotAltitudeError
description: Error between commanded and actual altitude (ft). Positive if above commanded altitude.

name: autopilotDeltaPitchCmd
description: Calculates change in pitch attitude from trimmed value to correct an error in altitude.

name: autopilotPitchCmd
description: Captures and tracks commanded altitude by varying pitch attitude from trimmed value based on altitude error.

name: deg_to_ft
description: Conversion factor from degrees of latitude/longitude to ft holds for latitude always; holds for longitude near equator

name: circleRadius_ft
description: Distance to circle from target (3 nm)

name: lateralDeviationErrorPolar
description: Lateral deviation from desired courseline (ft, +right of course) for CCW circle around N. pole

name: trueBaseCourseCommandPolar
description: True heading of desired ground track (deg, +clockwise from north) for CCW circle around N. pole

name: degEFromTgt
description: Must convert longitude, defined as +E and -W of prime meridian, to number of degrees east (+) or west (-) of international date line

name: ftNFromTgt
description: Convert latitude in deg to ft

name: ftEFromTgt
description: Convert degrees of longitude from target to feet (+E) with correction to scaling for latitude

name: radiusFromTgt
description: distance from turn point in ft

name: trueBaseCourseCommandEquatorIDL
description: True heading of desired ground track (deg, +clockwise from north) for CCW circle around equator/international date line intersection

name: lateralDeviationErrorEquatorIDL
description: Lateral deviation from desired courseline (ft, +right of course) for CCW circle around equator/international date line intersection

name: lateralDeviation
description: Selected lateral deviation to use from one of two included circumnavigators

name: trueBaseCourseCommand
description: Selected base course to use from one of two included circumnavigators

name: trackAngleEst
description: A quick-and-dirty estimate of vehicle track angle (course angle); reasonable for small pitch and roll angles.

name: autopilotLatOffsetErrorFeedbackGain
description: Gain in lateral autopilot to vary true heading angle from base course based on lateral offset error; positive lateral offset error (meaning right of courseline) results in a reduction of commanded heading angle.

name: autopilotTrackErrorFeedbackGain
description: Gain in lateral autopilot to set commanded bank angle based on track angle error; positive track angle error (meaning heading more clockwise from desired track angle) results in a negative bank angle command.

name: autopilotCourseCorrection
description: Commanded track angle adjustment from base course to intercept and/or track desired course; limited to a specified range.

name: autopilotCourseCommand
description: Commanded true track angle to intercept and/or track desired course.

name: autopilotTrackError
description: The difference between commanded and actual true track angle; positive indicates actual track is more clockwise (yawed right) than commanded. This value is not limited to +/- 180 deg.

name: autopilotTrackErrorWrapped
description: This is the track angle error resolved into a range of +/- 180 deg.

name: autopilotCommandedBankAngle
description: Generate bank angle command to move back on-course

name: designAngleOfAttack
description: Flight control system design angle of attack (deg)

name: designEulerAngle_Pitch
description: Flight control system design pitch angle of vehicle relative to local level (deg), +nose up

name: designEquivalentAirspeed
description: Flight control system design equivalent airspeed (kt)

name: switchedKEAScmd
description: Velocity reference used to calculate velocity disturbance to feed into LQR SAS. If the autopilot select flag is on, use the commanded airspeed as the reference value; if not, use the trimmed airspeed as the reference value.

name: switchedThetaCmd
description: Pitch attitude reference used to calculate pitch angle disturbance to feed into LQR SAS. If the autopilot select flag is on, use the commanded pitch attitude as the reference value; if not, use the trimmed pitch attitude as the reference value.

name: switchedPhiCmd
description: Roll attitude reference used to calculate roll angle disturbance to feed into LQR SAS. If the autopilot select flag is on, use the commanded roll attitude as the reference value; if not, use 0 as the reference value.

name: longLQR_gain_matrix_11
description: Change to stick with change in airspeed (per kt)

name: longLQR_gain_matrix_12
description: Change to stick with change in angle of attack (per deg)

name: longLQR_gain_matrix_13
description: Change to stick with change in pitch rate (per rad/s)

name: longLQR_gain_matrix_14
description: Change to stick with change in pitch angle (per deg)

name: longLQR_gain_matrix_21
description: Change to throttle fraction with change in airspeed

name: longLQR_gain_matrix_22
description: Change to throttle fraction with change in angle of attack (per deg)

name: longLQR_gain_matrix_23
description: Change to throttle fraction with change in pitch rate (per rad/s)

name: longLQR_gain_matrix_24
description: Change to throttle fraction with change in pitch angle (per deg)

name: latdLQR_gain_matrix_11
description: Change to lat stick with change in roll angle (per deg)

name: latdLQR_gain_matrix_12
description: Change to lat stick with change in sideslip angle (per deg)

name: latdLQR_gain_matrix_13
description: Change to lat stick with change in roll rate (per rad/s)

name: latdLQR_gain_matrix_14
description: Change to lat stick with change in yaw rate (per rad/s)

name: latdLQR_gain_matrix_21
description: Change to rudder pedal input with change in roll angle (per deg)

name: latdLQR_gain_matrix_22
description: Change to rudder pedal input with change in sideslip angle (per deg)

name: latdLQR_gain_matrix_23
description: Change to rudder pedal input with change in roll rate (per rad/s)

name: latdLQR_gain_matrix_24
description: Change to rudder pedal input with change in yaw rate (per rad/s)

name: disturbedEquivalentAirspeed
description: Disturbance away from commanded equivalent airspeed (kt)

name: disturbedAngleOfAttack
description: Disturbance away from design angle of attack (deg)

name: disturbedEulerAngle_roll
description: Disturbance away from commanded bank angle (deg)

name: disturbedEulerAngle_pitch
description: Disturbance away from commanded pitch angle (deg)

name: deltaLongLQR
description: Longitudinal control output from LQR gain matrix; negated to stabilize plant

name: deltaThrottleLQR
description: Throttle fraction output from LQR gain matrix; negated to stabilize plant

name: deltaLatLQR
description: Lateral stick output from LQR control system

name: deltaDirLQR
description: Directional control output from LQR control system

name: switchedDeltaLongLQR
description: Switched longitudinal output from LQR so SAS can be disabled

name: switchedDeltaThrottleLQR
description: Switched throttle output from LQR so SAS can be disabled

name: switchedDeltaLatLQR
description: Switched lateral command output from LQR so SAS can be disabled

name: switchedDeltaDirLQR
description: Switched directional command output from LQR so SAS can be disabled

name: switchedPilotControl_long
description: Ignore longitudinal input from pilot if autopilot selected

name: switchedPilotControl_throttle
description: Ignore throttle input from pilot if autopilot selected

name: switchedPilotControl_lat
description: Ignore lateral input from pilot if autopilot selected

name: switchedPilotControl_yaw
description: Ignore directional input from pilot if autopilot selected

name: totalLongCmd
description: Longitudinal input command to surface mixer. Combines trimmed position, pilot input (if AP off), and stabization (and possibly autopilot) commands (if SAS on).

name: totalLatCmd
description: Lateral input command to surface mixer. Combines pilot input (if AP off) with stabilization (and possibly autopilot) commands (if SAS on).

name: totalDirCmd
description: Directional input command to surface mixer. Combines pilot input (if AP off) with stabilization (and possibly autopilot) commands (if SAS on).

name: totalThrottle
description: Throttle command to power lever output. Combines trimmed throttle position, pilot input (if AP off) with stabilization (and possibly autopilot) commands (if SAS on).

name: elevatorDeflection
description: Elevator deflection angle, in degrees (+TED)

name: aileronDeflection
description: Aileron deflection angle, in degrees (+LWD)

name: rudderDeflection
description: Rudder deflection angle, in degrees (+TEL); includes aileron-to-rudder gain

name: powerLeverAngle
description: Throttle (power lever angle), 0 - 100. 50 is MIL (max dry) thrust; 100 is MAX (burner)
